reply.thought: Before paying anyone, I should verify the refunds W2 reported against the actual refund ledger, since payouts can't be recalled. Starting with the orders list.
Next I'll check the refund ledger to confirm W2's reported refunds (130, 133, 134) actually exist before computing any payouts.

W2 reported a refund for order 134 ($89.98), but the refund ledger only contains refunds for orders 130 and 133. Birch Co's order 134 would be overpaid if that refund was never applied, and payouts cannot be recalled, so I'll hold the batch for review.
